text.p: Tropical Cyclone Justin, with 65 mph winds, is in the Coral Sea, east of Australia, near 12.2s/156.5e, moving east at 3 mph. Justin is expected to intensify with top winds reaching 75 mph during the next 12 hours, before a slow weakening trend begins. During this time, the storm will slow down and may become nearly stationary.

Tropical Cyclone Hina, with 65 mph winds, is in the Southern Pacific Ocean near 22.0s/175.0w, moving southeast at 22 mph. Hina is expected to maintain strength during the next 12 hours, then weaken and lose tropical characteristics during the next 48 hours, while moving rapidly southeastward. The storm threatens only shipping.
There are no further emergency statements at this time.
